blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: учитель — teacher, instructor; роди́тель — parent; после́дователь — follower; зри́тель — spectator, onlooker, viewer.
**води́тель** — guide, leader (a person who guides others or leads the way). Wiktionary: води́ть + -тель.
